item.title: Palestinian shot dead during Israeli settler attack on occupied West Bank village
item.summary: The killing came as ex-security chiefs warned "government sponsored Jewish terrorism" was out of control.

item.title: Al Jazeera condemns killing of journalist in Israeli strike in Gaza
item.summary: The Israeli military claims Mohammed Wishah was a "Hamas terrorist" - which the Qatar-based network has previously denied.

item.title: Chimpanzees in Uganda locked in vicious 'civil war', say researchers
item.summary: The once close-knit community of Ngogo chimpanzees have been at loggerheads for the last eight years.

item.title: Gunmen kill at least four people at Afghanistan picnic spot
item.summary: Officials say attackers opened fire near the village of Deh Mehri in Herat.

item.title: Trump says Iran's handling of Strait of Hormuz is 'not the agreement we have'
item.summary: The US president accused Iran of "doing a very poor job" with the waterway as Israel and Lebanon to begin peace talks.

item.title: Dutch police urge victims of 'international sextortion campaign' to come forward
item.summary: Dutch police have warned that dozens of women and girls were coerced into degrading sexual acts on camera in several countries.

item.title: White House staff told not to place bets on prediction markets
item.summary: The gambling platforms have grown in popularity, with some users making wagers on conflicts.

item.title: Lebanon and Israel officials to meet in US on Tuesday
item.summary: A senior Lebanese official earlier told the BBC that Lebanon would only take part in talks if a ceasefire was in place.

item.title: French man charged with locking son in van for more than a year
item.summary: The boy was found malnourished, naked, lying next to human excrement and unable to walk, the prosecutor said.

item.title: South Korea deploys thermal imaging cameras in search for escaped zoo wolf
item.summary: The male wolf, named Neukgu, escaped a zoo in the central city of Daejeon on Wednesday, officials said.
